notes: Izu and Ogasawara islands (Miyakejima, Hachijojima, Chichijima, Hahajima) and the 24-hour ferry from Tokyo: the seabirds of the Pacific (Bonin Petrel, Matsudaira's and Tristram's Storm-Petrels, tropicbirds, boobies, albatrosses, shearwaters, noddies, terns) and the island songbirds (Bonin White-eye, Izu Thrush, Izu Robin, Owston's Tit, Ijima's Leaf Warbler, Japanese Murrelet). The model has no view on these; the list is hand-picked from eBird's lists for Ogasawara and the Izu islands. Photos are review-agent picks from unreviewed candidates (not approved on production): check them on /trip-photos. Shaky picks: Bonin White-eye (only 2 usable (others specimen/drawing/habitat); 882023 possibly captive); Japanese Murrelet (only distant birds at sea); Matsudaira's Storm-Petrel (only distant flight shots at sea; ID by pale primary shafts, moderate confidence); Izu Robin (several candidates look like Japanese Robin (grey belly) and were skipped; picks are brown-bellied orange-headed birds); Ijima's Leaf Warbler (leaf warbler lookalikes (Eastern Crowned/Arctic)).
